topic: Reading in dim light damages eyes? Myth vs fact

youtube.title: Reading in dim light ruins your eyes? Myth vs fact 💡 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Reading in dim light will ruin your eyes. Myth or fact?
மங்கலான வெளிச்சத்தில் படித்தால் கண் கெடுமா? உண்மை என்ன?

• Myth: dim light does not cause permanent eye damage
• But your eyes work harder to focus and you blink less: tired, dry eyes and headaches that go away with rest
• After 40, less light reaches the back of the eye, so you need much more light to read
• Put the lamp behind or beside you, not in front, and avoid glare on the page
• 20-20-20: every 20 minutes, look far away for 20 seconds
• Struggling to read even in good light? You may need glasses

gmb.text: Does reading in dim light ruin your eyes? It is a myth: low light does not cause permanent eye damage. It does make your eyes work harder. Your eyes strain to focus and you blink less, which leads to tired, dry eyes and headaches that go away with rest. As we age, less light reaches the back of the eye, so after 40 you may need much more light to read comfortably. Place a lamp behind or beside you, not in front, avoid glare on the page, and every 20 minutes look far away for 20 seconds. Reading your phone in a dark room? Turn on a room light and lower the brightness. If you still struggle to read even in good light, you may need glasses. Book an eye test on WhatsApp: 044 4356 9998
